steps.title: Prepare PCR Reaction
steps.instruction: Set up PCR reactions in at least two replicates, pipetting components in the specified order.

steps.title: Configure Thermocycler Parameters
steps.instruction: Set the thermocycler parameters based on the specific gene and amplicon size.

substeps.instruction: Set the annealing temperature (Step 3) according to the gene-specific sequences of the primers.
Adjust the extension time (Step 4 and Step 6) based on the amplicon size, using 30 s per kb.
For Step 6, run 30 cycles at 72 °C for the elongation phase using the adjusted extension time.

steps.title: Prepare 1% Agarose Gel
steps.instruction: Cast a 1% agarose gel using 1x TAE buffer and GelRed stain.

substeps.instruction: Dissolve agarose in 1x TAE buffer by microwaving for ~3 min, swirling every minute.
Add 2.5 µL of 10000x GelRed nucleic acid stain per 50 mL gel and mix well by swirling.
Wait 3-5 min after microwaving until the flask is almost cool enough to touch, then pour slowly into the gel tray and insert combs (use wide-wells for large PCR volumes).
Allow the gel to solidify for 45-60 min.
Remove combs and cover the gel with 1x TAE buffer.

steps.title: Run Gel Electrophoresis
steps.instruction: Separate the PCR products by size using electrophoresis.

substeps.instruction: Load 2-3 µL DNA ladder and the whole PCR samples into the gel pockets.
Connect the lid and run the power supply at 80-110 V (depending on gel thickness and size), ensuring DNA migrates toward the positive electrode.
Examine the gel after 30-60 min and run until the marker reaches the desired height.

steps.title: Extract and Clean DNA
steps.instruction: Isolate the target DNA from the gel.

substeps.instruction: Extract bands of the expected height from the gel.
Clean up the fragments using an extraction kit.

steps.title: Optional Re-amplification
steps.instruction: If insufficient DNA was produced, perform a second PCR.

substeps.instruction: Use the purified amplicon from the extraction as a template.
Skip the 5 initial rounds of the PCR protocol.
